notices.short_title: Proposed Rule - Amendment to Rules relating to Construction Superintendent License Qualifications
notices.plain: The Department of Buildings will hold a public hearing on March 23, 2026, on a proposed rule amending its rules for construction superintendent license qualifications.

notices.short_title: ancillary medical services
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services renewed its contract with The Floating Hospital Inc for ancillary medical services, worth $708,189.

notices.short_title: PAINTING SERVICES
notices.plain: The Office of Chief Medical Examiner awarded Amazonas Painting Corp a $1 million contract for painting services through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, without competition.

notices.short_title: Hunter College Uninterruptible Power Supply System - Main Campus Data Center
notices.plain: City University is seeking proposals for an uninterruptible power supply system for the main campus data center at Hunter College, with responses due March 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: OFFICE FURNITURE SEATING
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Nightingale Corp a $8.95 million contract for office seating through Competitive Sealed Bids, in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: HP LARGE FORMAT PRINTERS
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded Compulink Technologies Inc a $75,654 contract for HP large format printers, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: 82626Y0823-BWS Aquarius Software License SS 6010182X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection intends to award a services contract for Aquarius software licenses, with responses due Feb. 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: Mental Health trainings for clinicians
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded William M Zangwill a $88,800 contract for mental health trainings for clinicians, using a method the notice labels "Other.

notices.short_title: Creative Development of Public Education
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Bandujo Advertising and Design, Inc. a $10 million contract, chosen from competing proposals, for creative development of public education.

notices.short_title: M249-123M Penn South Playground Reconstruction, Manhattan
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Verdugos General Contractors Corp a $3,465,898 contract to reconstruct the Penn South Playground in Manhattan, chosen through competitive sealed bids among pre-qualified vendors where the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: 05626Y0225-Fixed Wing program management services for NYPD
notices.plain: The Police Department intends to award a contract for fixed-wing program management services, with responses to a request for information due March 3, 2026.

notices.short_title: Community Resources for Employment and Development Program (CRED)
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded Uplift Communities LLC a $1,982,625 contract for the Community Resources for Employment and Development Program (CRED), chosen through a negotiated acquisition from a pre-qualified list of approved vendors.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: FY26 Blank Purchase Order for specialty paper for HRA Print Shop
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration is seeking public comment on a fiscal 2026 blanket purchase order for specialty paper for its print shop.

notices.short_title: Tyler Technologies Inc Warrant Tracking Maintenance & Support
notices.plain: The Department of Finance's notice concerns maintenance and support for a warrant tracking system provided by Tyler Technologies Inc., and it invites public comment on that contract award.

notices.short_title: Discretionary/City Council/Expense Managed Care Consumer Assistance Program (MCCAP) Initiative
Multi-Year Veeam Recovery Orchestrator Renewal
notices.plain: The Department of Investigation published notice of a proposed multi-year renewal of its Veeam Recovery Orchestrator software contract, with the public invited to comment.

notices.short_title: Commercially Available Training: Science-Based Interview Foundations Course
notices.plain: The Police Department published notice of a public comment period on a contract award for a commercially available training course titled Science-Based Interview Foundations.

notices.short_title: Commercially Available Pilot and Maintenance Training
notices.plain: The Police Department is seeking public comment on its contract awards for commercially available pilot and maintenance training, according to a notice published Feb. 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: Applications Security, Storage and Optimization Services
Training Course Design and Development
notices.plain: The Taxi and Limousine Commission published a notice on Feb. 18, 2026, about a public comment period on a contract award for training course design and development.

notices.short_title: Technical project manager - Consulting Services

notices.short_title: Tax Levy Discretionary

notices.short_title: Public Notice of a Scoping Meeting, Fulton Park Rezoning, CEQR NO. 26DCP080K

notices.short_title: FEBRUARY 24, 2026 PUBLIC HEARING
notices.plain: The Community Boards agency will hold a public hearing on Feb. 24, 2026, as listed in The City Record notice published Feb. 18, 2026.

notices.short_title: CITY OF NEW YORK AUDIT COMMITTEE MEETING
notices.plain: The city comptroller's office will hold a City of New York Audit Committee meeting on Feb. 25, 2026.

notices.agency_name: Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City
notices.short_title: Meeting of the Board of Directors for the Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City

notices.short_title: EMERGENCY EXECUTIVE ORDER No. 2.7
